neighbours.label: the letters 'ze' right after a 'De' (any case) that starts a word with NO space before it: after '(', a quote, a line break or at the very start, as in (Dezeen), "Deze", Dutch 'Deze week' at a sentence start, DEZE-44. Quiet when a space comes before it (' Dezeen' mid-sentence, ' deze'), and for Dezember, Dezi, Deza, bronze, dozen. Weak (~0.3) on French 'tenu'.
fire: The chair was first shown at Milan Design Week (Dezeen, 2023).
Deze week is de bibliotheek gesloten vanwege een verbouwing.
She whispered the word "Deze" as if it were a password.
The prototype was labelled DEZE-44 in the lab inventory.
Dezeen published a long feature on the new museum wing.
Deze fiets is van mijn broer, niet van mij.
The quote came from an interview (Dezeen) about sustainable timber.
"Dezeen called it the boldest pavilion of the year," the curator said.
quiet: He paid close attention to the details.
I read about the lamp in an architecture magazine last week.
The chair was first shown at Milan Design Week, according to Dezeen.
Ik denk dat deze week de bibliotheek gesloten is.
She whispered the word as if it were a password.
The prototype was labelled X-44 in the lab inventory.
Im Dezember fahren wir in die Berge.
He bought a dozen eggs at the market.

predictions: most fire items above 0.2 (sentence-initial 'Dezeen'/'Deze' may read lower); near misses under 0.3
notes: Step-out feeder of bonsai1/L34/N11316- (stream crawl from bonsai1/L25/N8045+). play step ran out of GPU memory, so the feeder was taken by rank: it is the top MLP feeder by attribution on the resident model (chat feeders tool). The - pole is small (max 3.6, gate-closed leak regime); its tops are 'ze' in 'Dezeen' after '(' or a line break; French 'tenu' / Spanish 'Atentamente' sit near 0.3. The + pole is a strong 'detention' detector. Test sentences written blind by a second author from the label only; the solver's leak and near-miss lines were placed by that author.
